pages.text: Nothing. An island of unmade stone in it: a disc, causeways to four outcrops, and on each outcrop a pillar topped by a nail's head that holds nothing yet. In the middle, on a dais, the $(l)Cradle Stone$(), green runes round its top. Nothing waits there. Not until I bring it.

pages.title: The Last Offshoot
pages.text: After the Hadean, the Chronocortex asked to be taken there. It grows a $(l)Last Offshoot$() (research). Plant it in the Cradle. Then a $(l)Nerve Spool$(), drawn through a $(l)level 3 gland$() to thread it, rooted in the Chronocortex (use it on the cortex), and laid into the offshoot: it is the cortex then, there, with its name. Use it to wake it.

pages.title: What It Became
pages.text: It felt everything. It drank the time out of the four nails, and grew, and grew strange, and burst out of its jar. It is the $(l)Unbegotten$() now, and it says it will not bow. Its body rises past the north rim; four $(l)tentacles$() out of the void round the disc; two $(l)eyes$() on stalks by the south outcrop. Each can be killed on its own.

pages.title: Its Wounds Unhappen
pages.text: Until time begins, its wounds unhappen (every five seconds it is as whole as before), unless held in slowed or stopped time; but it tears any hold on time that lasts more than five seconds. The $(l)Unmade Nails$() take 24 drams of Time each from my blood: drive all four and time begins. Its tentacles slam across the causeways to keep me from them.

pages.title: Fighting It
pages.text: Watch the floor: rings of violet motes mark where it will strike, going green before they burst. Step out of them. Hack at a tentacle lying across a causeway (its flesh), or shoot the eyes; every living tentacle shields the body. Hide from an eye's gaze behind a pillar. Once time begins it sheds vexes; at the last its maw opens, drinks the air, and stars fall.

pages.title: While It Lives
pages.text: Nothing can be built on its arena (what was, it tears out), my tether goes slack and the shift does not end. Slain, it leaves its $(l)heart$() and two of the grafts it was growing. The arena is empty again after, for another offshoot.
